rows.headline: Bowls and pizza, hot when you get here.
rows.intro: Build your order, pick a time, and walk past the line. Everything comes out of the same wood oven we've had since day one.
rows.about: Bowls and pizza on Junction Ave since 2014.
rows.directions: We're the low brick building with the green awning. Pickup shelf is just inside the door, on your left — orders are filed by number.

rows.name: Signature grain bowl
rows.description: Charred broccoli, herb tahini, quick-pickled onion.

rows.name: Harvest squash bowl
rows.description: Roasted squash, farro, sage brown butter.

rows.name: Lemon chicken bowl
rows.description: Grilled chicken, jasmine rice, charred lemon.

rows.name: Sesame tofu bowl
rows.description: Crisp tofu, cabbage slaw, ginger sesame.

rows.name: Build your own pizza
rows.description: Start with our 48-hour dough and go from there.

rows.name: Margherita
rows.description: San Marzano, fior di latte, torn basil.

rows.notes: Office lunch — mostly pizza, a couple of vegan bowls, one without gluten if you can.
